swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: LMR33630ADDAR uses SOIC-8E (8-pin, DDA (8-Pin HSOIC PowerPAD)) while TPS54331DR uses SOIC-8 (8-pin, D); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs BOOT), Pin 4 (PG vs SS), Pin 6 (BYPASS vs COMP), Pin 7 (BOOT vs GND). Soldering TPS54331DR onto a LMR33630ADDAR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
Exposed thermal pad/tab mismatch (SOIC-8E: GND vs SOIC-8: NONE); PCB land pattern & solder-mask change required.

CRITICAL RECTIFICATION LAYOUT DIFFERENCE: TPS54331DR is non-synchronous and requires an external Schottky catch/freewheeling diode footprint near SW, whereas the counterpart integrates a synchronous low-side MOSFET.
HIGH MINIMUM OUTPUT VOLTAGE FLOOR: LMR33630ADDAR cannot regulate below 1 V (p.6) vs TPS54331DR down to 0.8 V (p.1); verify your target rail sits above the higher Vout,min floor.
HIGH VREF MISMATCH: Feedback reference differs (LMR33630ADDAR: 1 V p.7 vs TPS54331DR: 0.8 V p.5); dropping in without recalculating R1/R2 will output the wrong voltage rail.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (LMR33630ADDAR: 36 V p.6 vs TPS54331DR: 28 V p.4); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TPS54331DR has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (30 V, p.4) than LMR33630ADDAR (38 V, p.6); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 30 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 171% higher on TPS54331DR (LMR33630ADDAR: 42.9 °C/W p.7 vs TPS54331DR: 116.3 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (LMR33630ADDAR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ) vs TPS54331DR: -40..150 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to 150°C TJ)); LMR33630ADDAR hot limit only 125 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: LMR33630ADDAR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8E) and TPS54331DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs BOOT), Pin 4 (PG vs SS), Pin 6 (BYPASS vs COMP), Pin 7 (BOOT vs GND); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (GND vs BOOT), Pin 4 (PG vs SS), Pin 6 (BYPASS vs COMP), Pin 7 (BOOT vs GND). Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (non-sync), switching frequency 400 kHz (p.8) vs 570 kHz (p.6) (1.4x ratio), typical inductor 8 µH (p.20) vs 6.8 µH (p.16), feedback Vref 1 V (p.7) vs 0.8 V (p.5), and package θJA 42.9 vs 116.3 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: LMR33630ADDAR "Exposed PowerPAD IS the ONLY AGND Pin on 8-Pin DDA Package (Not Optional Heat Sink!)" (p.5) and TPS54331DR "Non-Synchronous Architecture Requires External Schottky Catch Diode & External COMP Network" (p.1). BOM decision: Choose LMR33630ADDAR when you want synchronous rectification without an external Schottky diode or bus voltage exceeds 28 V (rated to 36 V); choose TPS54331DR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOIC-8 (D) qualification and -40..150 °C grade. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.5 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
